messages:
maria: Customer on private deploy reports repeated 400s when using structured output with tool calls. Error says: \"ParseError: invalid JSON in function args: expected array for order_ids\". Happens only when traffic goes through their proxy after SDK upgrade.

sam: Can you paste the correlation id + raw request body we received?

maria: correlation_id: c-9a7f33. Raw body they send (from proxy logs): ```json
{ \"session\": \"user-982\", \"order_ids\": \"[123,456]\" }
``` Looks like order_ids got stringified.

jordan: That matches a proxy rewrite pattern we saw before — some proxies force everything to text/plain or call JSON.stringify on nested fields. Which SDK/version is the customer using?

maria: Customer says SDK 2.1.0. They also have an internal gateway that rewrites form posts into JSON. We reproduced: direct call to runtime with Content-Type: application/json works fine; sending through proxy yields content-type text/plain and the array becomes a string.

sam: Can you grab the runtime error logs and response headers for one of the failing requests?

maria: Runtime returned: \"Invalid function args: order_ids type mismatch: expected array but got string\". Runtime request id: rt-77ab12. Full response headers attached in ticket.

eng-oncall-bot: /escalate recommended actions:1) open SRE bridge2) add customer to private channel3) collect pcap of proxied request4) check proxy rewrite rules and middleware that touch body content.

jordan: Short-term workaround: detect stringified arrays before calling runtime and coerce them. E.g. if typeof order_ids === 'string' try JSON.parse and validate. Long-term: runtime should return a clearer 400 and optionally attempt a safe parse when strict structured output is disabled.

maria: Customer is seeing high retry volume (billing + latency issues). They've requested an urgent P2 fix and partial billing credit while we investigate.

sam: Assigning to eng-ml for quick patch to attempt parse of stringified arrays when a schema expects an array, plus a support action to issue a credit. Also preparing customer-facing note explaining root cause and workaround. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Created ticket INC-20260317-42, added account exec and billing.

maria: Added repro steps to the ticket including curl commands and a minimal proxy config snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-proxy.example.com/invoke -H \"Content-Type: text/plain\" --data '{"order_ids":"[123]"}'
```
This triggers the same 400 when proxied. Direct curl to runtime with Content-Type: application/json succeeds.

jordan: Also note for engineering: improve runtime error messaging to include the field path and provided type, e.g., \"order_ids: expected array, received string\". Check SDK retry logic to avoid double-encoding bodies during automatic retries.

sam: I'll follow up on SLA impact and internal comms. Thanks everyone, keeping this P2 until eng confirms mitigation.
